thread:
Sam W: Following the postmortem, we need clear owners/timelines for streaming reliability fixes (timeouts, partial responses, reconnect logic). I'll propose a split of work, please claim.

Maya K: Splitting infra vs SDK makes sense. Infra handles server keepalive, idle windows, and graceful reconnect acceptance. SDK handles backoff, resume tokens, and detection of incomplete finalization.

Priya S: I'll own SDK resume/backoff. Plan: add exponential backoff with jitter, cap retries at 5, and implement resume token handshake. Target: PR by Fri COB. Adding a feature flag so we can roll out gradually.

Jorge A: I'll own infra timeouts. Today: run a 2h cluster soak in eu-west-1 with lowered keepalive. If good, push config change to canary tomorrow. ETA: 3 business days for config + rollout.

Lucy H: QA will build regression harness for partial responses. Need sample prompts that produce long streams and an automation to inject mid-stream disconnects. ETA: 48h.

Sam W: Repro example from postmortem:
```
client: open_stream(session=xyz)
server: streaming tokens until 240
network: connection reset
client: no final event, app-level ack missing
```
Desired behavior: SDK detects incomplete finalization and resumes automatically, avoiding user-visible truncation.

Priya S: SDK backoff snippet I'll include:
```
for attempt in range(max_retries):
  wait = min(2 ** attempt + random_jitter(), 30)
  sleep(wait)
  if attempt > 0:
    resume_stream(last_ack_token)
```
Also adding a metric emit when resume occurs.

Maya K: Observability: add metric streaming.partial_response{model,region,route} and per-connection trace_id. I'll own dashboard and alerting. ETA: 5 days.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-3241 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3241

Jorge A: Early soak note: lowering keepalive reduced socket resets by ~70% in eu-west-1, but increased p99 for very small responses slightly. Will tune and iterate.

Sam W: Risk/rollback: config changes low risk but prepare rollback. Priya, feature flag required. Maya, define 2h canary and rollback criteria. Lucy, hold broad QA until canary passes.

Lucy H: Preparing harness and probes for mid-stream drop simulation. Will attach prompt list and test plan when ready.

Priya S: Tracker RDW-8112 created: "SDK auto-resume + backoff" assigned to me, target Fri. Will include integration test and feature flag.

Maya K: Tracker RDW-8113: "partial_response metric + dashboard" assigned to me, ETA next Wed. Will include rollback runbook.

Jorge A: Tracker RDW-8114: "server keepalive tuning + canary" assigned to me, canary tomorrow morning.

Sam W: Recap owners/timelines:
- Infra (timeouts/keepalive): Jorge A 13 3 days (RDW-8114)
- SDK (resume/backoff): Priya S 13 Fri COB (RDW-8112)
- Observability: Maya K 13 next Wed (RDW-8113)
- QA harness: Lucy H 13 48h

Sam W: Action: post EOD status here and then daily until metrics are green. Reassign if needed.

Priya S: Ack, will post PR link when ready.
